item.text: The current evaluator is entirely inside `storage/rule.go`. I found two correctness issues in that path as well: rules are iterated from a map after being fetched in rank order, and operator validation lowercases the name without applying that normalization during comparison. I’m carrying the evaluator into its own file and fixing those behaviors there.

The server now depends on `storage.Evaluator`, and the SQL evaluator owns flag lookup, constraint matching, and rollout selection. I’ve also preserved rank order explicitly and adjusted the bucket search to include exact cutoff values. I’m running the affected test packages now.

item.text:
Implemented the evaluator split. `Server.Evaluate` now delegates to `storage.Evaluator`, and [EvaluatorStorage](/app/storage/evaluator.go) owns flag lookup, constraint matching, and variant selection. The evaluation path now preserves rule rank, handles case insensitive operators and trimmed strings, and uses deterministic CRC32 rollout cutoffs.

Updated the mocks and added focused evaluator tests. `GOPROXY=off go test ./storage ./server` passes.
